description: This file handles the save and execution of reports in a vtiger CRM module, including processing request parameters, permission checks, report generation logic, chart rendering, and rendering of report-related UI components.

classes.name: Reports
classes.description: Class representing report management in vtiger CRM, instantiated as $ogReport.

classes.name: ReportRun
classes.description: Class used for executing report logic, instantiated as $oReportRun.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty templating class for rendering HTML views.

methods.name: getPrimaryStdFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for the standard filter options for a primary module in a report.

methods.name: getSecondaryStdFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for the standard filter options for a secondary module in a report.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumns_AdvFilter_HTML
methods.description: Returns HTML <option> tags for available primary module columns for advanced filter selection.

methods.name: getAdvCriteria_HTML
methods.description: Creates HTML options for advanced filter criteria selections.
